claims: Netflix has renewed Tyler Perry's "Beauty in Black" for a third and final season.
Season 3 of "Beauty in Black" is scheduled to arrive in 2026.
Season 2, Part 2 of "Beauty in Black" is scheduled to release in March 2026.
"Beauty in Black" is confirmed to end with its third season.
Tyler Perry serves as creator, director, and writer for the Netflix drama "Beauty in Black".
The first season of "Beauty in Black" reached No. 1 in 28 countries.
Taylor Polidore Williams plays Kimmie in "Beauty in Black".
In the season 3 plot of "Beauty in Black", Kimmie controls the Bellarie business.
In season 3 of "Beauty in Black", Kimmie faces rivalry from Mallerie.
In season 3 of "Beauty in Black", Kimmie protects her friends Rain and Sylvie.
